title: CIBuzzBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Understanding of Chinese Internet Buzzwords
abstract: arXiv:2609.21722v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chinese social media has generated a vast and continually evolving lexicon of internet buzzwords whose meanings are often non-literal and deeply rooted in local cultural and pragmatic contexts. Existing research has primarily focused on interpreting these buzzwords within Chinese, leaving largely unexplored whether LLMs can transfer such culturally grounded knowledge across languages and accurately convey the intended meanings in English. This cross-lingual capability is also critical for safety, as harmful expressions may obscure their offensive content through culture-specific homophony, euphemism, irony, or coded language. In this paper, we investigate the ability of advanced LLMs to understand Chinese internet buzzwords across languages. To this end, we introduce CIBuzzBench, the first benchmark for cross-lingual Chinese-to-English understanding of Chinese internet buzzwords. CIBuzzBench comprises 3,001 Chinese internet buzzwords a

translated_title: CIBuzzBench：一个用于中文网络流行语跨语言理解的基准测试
translated_abstract: 中文社交媒体产生了大量且不断演变的网络流行语词汇，其含义往往并非字面意思，而是深深植根于当地文化和语用语境之中。现有研究主要集中于在中文语境内解释这些流行语，而对于大语言模型（LLMs）能否将这种基于文化的知识跨语言迁移，并在英语中准确传达其预期含义，则很大程度上尚未被探索。这种跨语言能力对安全也至关重要，因为有害表达可能通过文化特有的谐音、委婉语、反讽或暗语来掩盖其冒犯性内容。在本文中，我们研究了先进大语言模型跨语言理解中文网络流行语的能力。为此，我们推出了CIBuzzBench，这是首个用于中文网络流行语中英跨语言理解的基准测试。CIBuzzBench包含3,001个中文网络流行语……
tldr: 本文提出了首个中文网络流行语中英跨语言理解基准CIBuzzBench（包含3,001个流行语），用于评估大语言模型将植根于中国文化的网络流行语知识跨语言迁移的能力，这一能力对内容安全同样至关重要。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CIBuzzBench, the first benchmark comprising 3,001 Chinese internet buzzwords for evaluating LLMs' cross-lingual Chinese-to-English understanding of culturally grounded buzzwords, a capability that is also critical for safety.
